description: Explicit pinned SHAs for the cross-repository integrity workflow (.github/workflows/cross-repo-integrity.yml). Update deliberately, in the same PR as the change that requires a new pin, never silently.

data-connect.note: Head of PDP-Connect/data-connect main as of 2026-09-02 (merge of data-connect#49, 'fix(polyfill-connectors): sync codex from canonical (sessions-archive/ scan)' — re-vendors codex/{index.ts,parsers.ts,ARCHIVAL-CONTRACT.md} and their test files, which had drifted from this repo's canonical copies after data-connectors#63 landed the codex sessions-archive/ scan there). Supersedes the prior 82a45176 pin (2026-09-02, this same day): pin-freshness — data-connect had gone red on packages/polyfill-connectors/connectors/codex (this repo's own connector-source drift check agreed — see check-connector-source-drift.mjs's job, which failed on data-connectors#63 for exactly this reason). No re-vendor of packages/polyfill-connectors/vendor/pdpp-collector-runtime-0.0.1.tgz or vendor/pdpp-connector-protocol-0.0.1.tgz was needed: `git diff 82a45176..a72cb53a -- packages/collector-runtime packages/connector-protocol` is empty (data-connect#49 touched only packages/polyfill-connectors), confirmed via a fresh repack from this SHA that both tarballs still match the committed vendor/SHA256SUMS digests byte-for-byte. This is a SHA-reference-only update, same as the data-connect-1-0-0 pin's own precedent for an unrelated-diff move. Source of truth for drift jobs (a) collector-definitions snapshot, (b) vendored connector sources, and the 0.0.1 half of (c) tarball digests — re-ran all three locally against this SHA before moving the pin: all three report OK.

data-connect-1-0-0.note: A SEPARATE, later data-connect SHA used ONLY by the 1.0.0 half of drift job (c) tarball-digests — deliberately NOT the same value as the `data-connect` pin above. pdpp's vendor/SHA256SUMS (see pdpp's vendor/README.md 'Current 1.0.0 release-boundary pins') records pdpp-collector-runtime-1.0.0.tgz / pdpp-connector-protocol-1.0.0.tgz packed from data-connect PR #36's tree — this is PR #36's merge commit into main ('Add local collection and release checks', merged 2026-09-02T07:53:00Z), superseding the prior 10f25a3cd6 pin which recorded the PR's pre-merge head commit. Confirmed via `git diff 10f25a3cd6..b70dda89a -- packages/collector-runtime packages/connector-protocol scripts/pin-collector-runtime-protocol-dependency.ts` (empty — the merge is a true two-parent merge of the reviewed branch, not a squash, so the packages this pin backs are byte-identical between the two commits; the merge additionally picked up an unrelated repo-wide SPDX-header sweep and other main-tip drift, none of it touching these paths) that the previously-vendored 1.0.0 tarballs still reconcile: no re-vendor needed, this is a SHA-reference-only update. This SHA is NOT used for jobs (a)/(b) or the 0.0.1 tarball repack: data-connect's local-collector/collector-runtime/connector-protocol sources changed materially between the `data-connect` pin above and this one (STREAM_EVIDENCE outcomes-partition wire change, capability-array validation, package-artifact receipts), so reusing this SHA for the shared `data-connect` pin would flip jobs (a)/(b) and the 0.0.1 repack from passing to failing — those still compare against data-connectors' and pdpp's committed 0.0.1 artifacts, which were packed from the OLDER `data-connect` pin and have not been repinned to 1.0.0 themselves. Revisit consolidating these two pins into one only once data-connectors' own packages/polyfill-connectors/vendor/ moves off 0.0.1.

pdpp.note: Head of PDP-Connect/pdpp main as of 2026-09-02T19:28:07-05:00 (merge of PR #284, 'waspflow/move-b-step7-remove-reference-implementation-0902' — deletes reference-implementation/, apps/console, packages/cli, packages/mcp-server, and packages/read-core entirely; canonical home is now PDP-Connect/data-connect). Supersedes the prior d2512e22c pin (branch waspflow/move-b-step7-remove-reference-implementation-0902, moved there by #61 to deliberately track PR #284's head before merge): now that #284 has merged, this pin's `branch` field drops back to `main` as #61's own note anticipated ('once pdpp#284 merges to main, this pin's branch field should drop back to main in a routine follow-up repin'). This routine follow-up was overdue — main had been red on Pin freshness / Cross-Repo Integrity Gate since #284 merged, because `branch: waspflow/move-b-step7-remove-reference-implementation-0902` pointed at a now-deleted branch (`git fetch` for a tracked ref that no longer exists hard-fails the job, exit 128, before it can even diff). A separate PR already landed the companion script/README fix this repin depends on (check-reference-contract-drift.mjs's LOCAL_STAND_IN_MAPPINGS emptied, src/reference-implementation-stand-in/README.md's 'Removal trigger' section updated to reflect pdpp#284 deleting reference-implementation/ outright rather than moving it to a package) — this commit only had to move sha/branch, the drift-check code was already fixed. Verified packages/reference-contract is byte-identical across d2512e22c → 498818a9b (`git diff d2512e22c..498818a9b -- packages/reference-contract` empty) — drift job (c)'s pdpp half and (d)'s vendored-tarball half are unaffected. Re-verified pdpp's own vendor/SHA256SUMS against a fresh `sha256sum vendor/*.tgz` at 498818a9b: unchanged, all three digests match. Confirmed reference-implementation/, apps/console, packages/cli, packages/mcp-server, packages/read-core are all absent from pdpp main's tree at this SHA (`git ls-tree` empty for each). Re-ran check-reference-contract-drift.mjs locally against a fresh pdpp clone at 498818a9b: passes (`OK: all documented reference-contract stand-in modules match their canonical pdpp source`). Simulated the pin-freshness job's own fetch-and-compare logic locally against live pdpp main: trivially fresh (current HEAD equals this pinned SHA). data-connect pin (82a45176e / a72cb53a8 in the sibling PR) is unchanged by this update.
